en:
Well, if the culprit's gonna confess, then I
guess even morons can't screw this up...

The blackened who killed Kokichi Oma
is Kaito Momota! You all got it right!

So you all got it right, huh? Even
Shuichi and Maki Roll voted for me...

What a relief! Well, I knew you 
guys wouldn't get it wrong.

But man was it hard to act
like Kokichi the whole time.

I mean, sure, he wrote 
most of his own lines.

Seriously, look at this huge script.
He wrote the whole thing.

It's even got a bunch of alternate
lines for different events, too.

But even so, I still had to ad-lib.
You guys couldn't tell though, huh?

Hey, c'mon guys...
Don't look so sad...

You guys got it right.
It's all good.
Why...?
Hm?
Why...did you kill Kokichi?

You were against the killing game...
So why did you kill him?

I believed...that you absolutely wouldn't
do...such a thing...
Maki...

<CLT=cltMIND>Was she protecting Kaito...
or just believing in him, like me...?

Yeah, I should explain.
Most of it's just like Shuichi said.

After Kokichi pretended to take
the antidote, he gave it to me...

Then he told me I had to
cooperate with his plan...
Plan? What plan?

I-I've been thinking...this whole time...of
a plan to throw the mastermind off guard...

Throw them off guard? What are you
talking about? You're the mastermind!

Ohhh...um, that was a lie...
I-I only pretended to be the mastermind...
Pretended!?

You all fell for it...
But y'know...I prepared a bunch of stuff...

Like this remote control...
I had Miu make it...

The mysterious message in the courtyard...
Using Gonta and making him a murderer...

All that preparation was just to make you
guys think I was the mastermind.

Wh-What the hell!?
Why'd you do all that...?

The reason why...I pretended to be the
mastermind...
...was to end this boring killing game!
To end it?

I thought if I showed you the <CLT=cltSTRONG>despairing truth<CLT=typeNORMAL>,
you guys wouldn't want to go outside anymore...
I thought it would end the killing game.

But instead...this happened.
I'm gonna die by Maki's hands...

Why do you think this happened?
Why do you think Maki tried to kill me?

Why do you think the killing game started
again?
Why...?

Because the <CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL> instigated it.
I'm certain of it.

They made a move...without us noticing.
Maaan...thanks to that, everything is ruined...
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL> instigated it?

So whoever that person is, they also
instigated Maki's actions, too?

Yeah...they probably tried to eliminate me
because I pretended to be the mastermind...

...My actions were instigated by the true
mastermind?

B-But that can't be... The reason I
decided to kill Kokichi was...

...because I remembered the truth from
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

Maybe...making you remember the truth
was <CLT=cltSTRONG>what the mastermind wanted<CLT=typeNORMAL>...
...What?

Maybe the <CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL> had us use
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Lights<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

...so we would target Kokichi as a Remnant
of Despair?

So the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=typeNORMAL> itself was the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL>'s trap all along?

They expected us to target Kokichi once we
remembered he was a Remnant of Despair?

Kokichi certainly expected it. That's why
he talked about <CLT=cltSTRONG>the true mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...even so, this is all rather
convenient for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>The person claiming to be the mastermind
just so happened to be a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=cltMIND>?

<CLT=cltMIND>We're all students of Hope's Peak Academy, and
our fates are tied to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>I never would have imagined that fate
would bring us to Kokichi's murder.

<CLT=cltMIND>It just plays too nicely
for <CLT=cltSTRONG>the true mastermind<CLT=cltMIND>.

I didn't know about that <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
Guess that's another mystery for you.
Anyway, like I was saying...
Then who is this <CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL>!?
Wh-Who knows...I dunno either...

But it doesn't matter...we can't lose...
This game is pointless...unless you win.
That's why...I thought of a special plan...
When I'm on the verge of losing...
...my plan will help me win!

I don't really get it, but is this the 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>plan to throw off the mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL>?

Well, it's not that difficult...
Kaito...I need you...
...to kill me.
Wha-!?

The plan was...to make a case
where the victim was unknown.

And then trick Monokuma into thinking
<CLT=cltSTRONG>I was the victim<CLT=typeNORMAL> so he'd mess up.

If he ruled that either Maki Roll
or Kokichi were the blackened...

Then I'd show myself and 
Monokuma's ruling would be invalid.

And if Monokuma's ruling was invalid, 
the killing game would end.

That's what I'm most curious about.
What makes you think it would end?

Yeah, I asked Kokichi about
that myself.

Why would Monokuma care if he
messed up on who the blackened was?
And...this is what he said.

Even if it's Monokuma or the <CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL>,
they can't break the rules as they please...
Being unfair like that...isn't allowed...
What do you mean?
Death games are meant to be <CLT=cltSTRONG>watched<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

If no one was <CLT=cltSTRONG>watching<CLT=typeNORMAL>, there would be no reason
to be such a stickler about the rules...

There would be no point in making this a game
in the first place...

But Monokuma's been a stickler about the rules,
and about making the game interesting.

That's why he agreed to my plan
in the Virtual World...

Which means Monokuma is aware that someone
is watching us...

In which case...I have no doubt that this
death game is being shown to someone.
So...this is some kind of show!?

But who'd be watching? We're the only
people left alive, aren't we?

That's right! The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=typeNORMAL> is the
reason we even remember that!

But Kokichi mighta been right. Why have 
a death game if no one's watching?

I wasn't sure about it at first, but after
this class trial, there's no doubt.

Monokuma can't do whatever he wants.
He's bound by the rules of the game.

That's why he couldn't afford to get the
culprit wrong. Why he relied on Shuichi.

It's just like Kokichi said! If this game's rules
matter so much, someone's watching.

<CLT=cltMIND>A death game is made
to be watched...
<CLT=cltMIND>If that's true, then...who?
<CLT=cltMIND>Who...is watching this?
What's this all about, Monokuma!?

Is this killing game really a show
for someone!?
Puhuhu... Who can say?

Nyeh!? Why won't you tell us!?
We were friends during the trial!

...Honestly, I was just happy you guys
cooperated with me.

Humans love to help. They jump at any
opportunity to extend a helping hand.
Then, here's another question—

Who are you, really? If Kokichi, a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant
of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>, is not the mastermind...

Then who's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL>? Is it
another <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> like him?

I'm not gonna spill the beans on a perfect
"To Be Continued" cliffhanger like that!
Wh-Why you...are just too cute!
Huh? Really?

I understand Kokichi's plan, but...why did 
you agree to work with him, Kaito?
Why did you agree to kill Kokichi?

Because he saved your life? 
You should've just...ignored him.
He's better off dead anyway...

It was kinda hard to ignore
such an annoying guy.
...What?

Geez... I wonder how far ahead he
planned this evil scheme of his.
Y-Yeah but...killing you...

What are you talking about!?
You want me to kill you!?
I figured you'd react like that...
But...are you sure you're okay with that?

Because if this poison kills me, then Maki
would become the blackened.
And her crime would be exposed so easily.

If that happened, then Maki and I would've
died for no reason, right?
Which is just what the <CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL> expects...
Wha-!

Dammit...that's playing dirty!
So that's why you gave me the antidote...

Nee-heehee... I *am* the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme
Leader<CLT=typeNORMAL>. There are no depths I won't sink to.
...Even if I have to sacrifice myself.

Anyway...this is our chance...
Our chance to end this killing game.

That's why...you have to kill me, so we can
win and ruin this killing game...

We'll bring the <CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL> and
everyone who's watching...
...We'll bring them down to utter <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>!

Then everyone who died can rest in peace!
Ah-hahahahahaha!!!

...Ack, aw crap. I'm gonna die soon...
Can we get this started already?
You're seriously crazy, dude.
Nee-heehee... But, y'know...
I...wasn't boring, right?
Then...he blackmailed you by using me!?

No. I agreed to his plan once I heard
the words "ruin this killing game".

He was crazy, but that let him come
up with some crazy plans...

And we needed a crazy plan in order to 
stand a chance against Monokuma.

I bet on that chance.
I didn't have any other choice...
Cuz...I'm outta time.
Time...
Kaito... You mean, your health...?

But you said you were fine! You told me
not to worry about it anymo—
Ah, my bad. That was a lie.
A-A lie...?

Haha, yeah it's pretty bad.
Honestly, I'm at my limit just talking.
N-No...it can't be...

But I gotta wonder how this happened.
I don't remember at all.

In <CLT=cltSTRONG>my memories<CLT=typeNORMAL>, I was fine during the
medical exam for my training...

<CLT=cltMIND>If he was fine during the medical
exam, then that means...
This might be...the virus.
Virus?

One of the plagues that
caused our planet to crumble.

A virus carried by meteorites that
spread across the globe.

Hope's Peak Academy, along with the rest
of the planet, was in danger of extinction.

Even though we had come so far and
triumphed over so much despair...
we were almost wiped out in an instant.

This must have something
to do with the virus.

Kaito didn't use that <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
so he might not remember it...

But weren't we supposed to be immune?
We were selected because we didn't-

Perhaps the virus was dormant when you
were selected for the Gofer Project...

You could've been infected the whole time,
showing no symptoms until very recently.
W-What!?

Kaito is...infected with the virus!?
But how could that be!?

I dunno what you're talking about, but...
I guess I'm pretty screwed, huh?

Well, I knew this was coming. 
That's why I agreed to Kokichi's plan.

But you know, when I found out about 
the plan, I thought it was pretty awesome.

Kokichi left me with a whole outline
of it. I freaked out when I read it.

It was a pretty good plan. I thought
we might be able to trick Monokuma.

But I knew Shuichi'd see right 
through it in the end!
...What?

Haha, and that's exactly how it went!
Nice job, Shuichi! You're really something!
Kaito, did you...

Yeah, I knew you guys would
figure everything out.

That's why I was able to get on board 
with Kokichi and lie to you like that.

Even if I messed stuff up during the
trial, I knew Shuichi'd see the truth.

Heh. Just what I'd expect from
my sidekick.

Wh-Why...?
If you knew I'd see through it, why—

If you knew it was pointless from the start,
then you shouldn't have gone that far...!

Nah, it wasn't pointless.
It ended up being a huge success.
W-Why?

Because of this plan and Kokichi
pretending to be the mastermind...

We got closer to the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind's<CLT=typeNORMAL> lair...

Behind this truth, there's gotta
be a hint that leads to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>real truth<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
The real truth?

Yeah, no doubt.
That's why Kokichi gave his life.

You talk as if...he was your partner.
When you hated him so strongly before...

Oh, I hate his guts.
Honestly, I'm still pissed off at him.

He made us go through so much crap.
To the end— No, even beyond that...
He was a lying sack of shit.

I-It's getting...harder to breathe, so...
Please...can you...

Hey, can I ask one thing?
You want to ruin this killing game, but...
You kept saying how fun this game was.
That was a lie...obviously...

H-How could a game...that you're 
forced to play...be fun...?

I had to think this game was fun to survive...
I had to lie to myself!
You little...

The bastards who created this game to toy
with our lives...and the shits enjoying it...
They all...piss me off!

Th-That's why...I'm willing to do whatever
it takes...to end this game!
Kokichi said...that?

That coulda been a lie, too. He probably 
just said it so I'd cooperate with him.

Was it really a lie...? I think his dying words
may have been the honest truth...

No, it's definitely a lie. He's not the
type to shed real tears.
I wonder which one it is...
<CLT=cltMIND>A lie...or the truth?

<CLT=cltMIND>Even now at the very end,
I don't really understand Kokichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>But maybe that's what <CLT=cltSTRONG>lying<CLT=cltMIND>
is all about.

<CLT=cltMIND>The truth is in the
eye of the beholder, huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi...was the very
embodiment of a <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltMIND>.

That pretty much wraps up 
my explanation. Now, finally...
I need to apologize to Shuichi...
What? Me?

To be honest...
I was jealous of you.
Jealous...?

Because you were always 
saving us, y'know?
Your detective skills kept us alive...

You were just way too cool,
and I got frustrated...

So that's why I was so harsh
on you. My bad...

Hey...
No, Kaito, that's not true...

I was only so confident because
you were there for me, Kaito.

When you made me your sidekick, you
said that you'd "take the responsibility"...
And that... That's why I can do all this.

If you didn't talk to me back
then, even now I'd be—
Hrkh!
*cough* *cough* *cough*
Kaito!?
K-Kaito!
Kaito, are you okay!?

Heh... H-How can I be okay?
I'm...about to die...

You sure are, bucko!
Cuz it's punishment time!
Punishment!?
...I won't let you...
...I won't let you kill Kaito!

Oh? You planning to get in my way? You know
what'll happen if you do that, don't you?

I don't care what happens!
I planned to kill you anyway from the start.

Y-Yes... I've been determined to fight back
for a while now...
N-No... Stop...

No, Kaito, I can't!
I can't let you die, Kaito!

I don't care if you're sick! I don't care if
you're dying! I won't let Monokuma touch you!
...Puhu.
Puhuhuhuhuhuhu.
Puhuhuhuhuhuhuhuhuhuhuhuhuhuhuhu.
Wh-What's so funny...?

Oh, just thinkin' about life...and how
irreplaceable it is. Know what I mean?
What...?

When a life ends, those closest to it mourn.
But if you could somehow recycle that life...

Then those closest to it wouldn't need to
mourn anymore, right?

If we could recycle life, the world would
be filled with hope. That's my point.
What are you talking—
Alright, kids! Time for your grand re-entrance!

Rise and shine, ursine! With our powers
combined, we are the Monokubs!
Huh?

I'm Monotaro! No matter how you read it
or spell it or say it, it's still Monotaro!
What the-!? That's totally a lie!

What the hell's goin' on? I coulda swore
there was more of youse chumps before!

Fuck if I know! Let's destroy Monodam now!
This sadsack is bummin' me the fuck out!

W-What the!? Weren't all the 
Monokubs completely destroyed!?

Those <CLT=cltSTRONG>old<CLT=typeNORMAL> Monokubs were destroyed.
These Monokubs are the <CLT=cltSTRONG>latest model<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

They still got their factory settings, so in a
way, it's like they're brand-new characters...

But who cares!? Now that my cubs are back,
I'm not lonely and miserable anymore!

You...brought them back on
a whim like that?

You guys are just as replaceable. Maybe not
as replaceable as the Monokubs...

But finding other people to participate in this
killing game is easier than ya might think.
<CLT=cltMIND>Finding other people?

I got no idea what's goin' on or what any
of this means, but that's right!

Hell yeah! We're so fuckin' lovable and shit!
Except Monodam, of course!
Oh, do you know what else this means?

Now that the Monokubs are back, I've got
my Exisal entourage protecting me again.
Still wanna defy me now?

Th-This is bad!
If he's got the Exisals again-
So what?

It doesn't matter... I won't let you kill Kaito.
I'll...fight until the end...

S-Stop... Even if you fight the
Exisals, you'll just get killed, dammit!

The remote control and the last
Electrobomb were crushed in the press.
No, I won't give up.

Maki Roll!
Enough alre-
I've never felt this way before!

I've always fought to kill, but...this is the first
time I've fought to protect someone!
Huh?
And...I've never...

...been given a nickname like "Maki Roll"
before, either.
You...
And I've never...
...met someone as stubborn as you before...
And...I've never...
...fallen for someone before.
Maki Roll!
Maki...

I...don't want this to end.
I just...don't...

That's why I won't let you kill Kaito!
I absolutely won't let you!

Maki Roll... I'm sorry...
but that's not an option.

I don't have as much 
time left as you think...
I'm...fighting just to stay standing.
B-But, I...

Hey, Maki Roll. I asked you before...
What's your enemy?

Before...you hated yourself so much.
You didn't even like yourself a little...

And wasn't that the reason you tried 
to distance yourself from others?

You decided that you didn't deserve 
to have friends, didn't you?
That was your enemy.

But not anymore, huh?
You're alright now!

You fell for a guy like me!
Now you can learn to like yourself!
U-Ugh...uuugh...

Hey, hey...don't cry. Can't you send 
me off with one last smile?

You guys, too. I'm not gonna allow 
any tears. Send me off with a bang.

Alright...Kaito.
I...won't cry.
M-Me too! I'm gonna hold it in!
Yeah! I'll endure it!
I can't cry. Even if I wanted to...

Hey, sorry about the wait, Monokuma.
You can go ahead and start now.
Can do!

Oh boy! My first Punishment Time!
I've never seen one before!

But let me just say this to the true 
mastermind controlling Monokuma...

You better get ready!
My friends aren't gonna lose to you!
That's all.

I'll leave the rest to you guys!
End this ridiculous killing game!
We'll end it. So, please...don't worry.

And Shuichi...
Never forget, you're not alone.

You have friends. Don't try to do
everything by yourself, okay?
...Yeah, Kaito. Okay.

Don't forget! The impossible is possible!
All you gotta do is make it so!
Yeah! Thanks, Kaito!

Maki Roll... How long are you gonna cry?
You should smil-

I-I can't...
That's impossible... I can't...

Haha...of course... My bad for making you
cry like that.
Ugh... U-Uuuugh...
Alright then! Let's end this with a bang!

A special punishment suited to the
Luminary of the Stars!

You don't gotta tell me! I'm excited
to get this started!

Oh yeah? Well screw you!
I'm not gonna die the way you want!
It's...PUNISHMENT TIME!!!
